answers.assumption_check: Load-bearing: the proof is Linux-only because systemd user units and /proc are its measuring instruments, not a path bug. Measured: four teeth die at systemctl (a missing tool), not at a wrong path. Not assumed: that Windows needs no coverage of the first-shim-starts-the-loop behaviour; ensure_ground_loop's detached-Popen branch is a different path this proof never measured, and a Windows port would be its own ticket.
answers.builder_check: A Haiku builder needs: the file and where the check goes (the top of main(), before any tooth), the two conditions (shutil.which('systemctl') is None, or not Path('/proc').is_dir()), the exact line and a non-zero return, and that nothing else in the file changes. The ticket carries all of these.
